notes: Manufacturer page rticontrol.com/xp-8v-control-processor.html and the cutsheet/manual PDFs on rticontrol.com now 302-redirect to avproglobal.com (RTI's parent/successor storefront); used the AVPro Global product page (current authoritative RTI source) plus corroborating manual excerpts (ManualsLib/Manualzz mirrors of the official XP-8v Reference Guide) and the Snap One/AV-iQ spec listings. RS-232 ports are RJ45 jacks wired for 3-wire RS-232 (568B pinout), shipping with 8x RJ45-to-DB9 adapters — modeled here as rs232 connector since that's the electrical standard, note the physical jack is RJ45. MPIO ports are custom 3.5mm 4-conductor (TRRS-style) jacks used for IR emitters/RTI modules/voltage sensing — modeled as trs-3.5 (closest listed connector); not full-duplex audio. Sense inputs and relay/trigger outputs terminate on included pluggable terminal blocks (3x 4-position + 3x 2-position ship in box) — modeled as euroblock (closest listed connector) rather than true dry-contact relay to bare wire. Relay outputs are actually low-voltage programmable outputs (12VDC@100mA or dry-contact-configurable), not high-current speaker/mains relays. RTI-COM (Zigbee) port and the Expansion (RS-485/IR/PWR) port are both RJ45-keyed proprietary ports, not standard Ethernet — included anyway as rj45 bidirectional control ports since no better id exists; grade omitted since they are not Ethernet-speed-graded. USB: two rear Host ports + one front Programming port; exact USB revision (2.0 assumed, standard for this control-processor generation) and Programming port's physical sub-connector (A vs Mini/Micro) could not be confirmed from available sources — modeled all three as usb-a/usb-2.0, flagged as inferred. Power input is a 12VDC/1A wall-adapter barrel jack (same PS-2 style supply shared across RTI's XP-8/XP-8s/XP-6 family per third-party PSU listings); modeled as dc-barrel. HDMI OSD output version not stated by RTI (spec only says "720p/1080p" resolution support) — omitted grade since no HDMI spec revision (1.4/2.0/2.1) is published.

ports.name: RS-232 1-8
ports.note: 8x two-way RS-232 ports on RJ45 jacks (568B pinout); ships with 8x RJ45-to-DB9 adapters for standard serial gear

ports.name: MPIO 1-8
ports.note: 8x Multi-Purpose I/O ports, custom 3.5mm 4-conductor jacks; used for IR emitters/blasters, RTI RS-232 modules, or voltage sensing

ports.name: Sense 1-8
ports.note: 8x contact-closure/voltage (2-12VDC) sense inputs on pluggable terminal block

ports.name: Relay/Trigger 1-8
ports.note: 8x outputs on pluggable terminal block, configurable as dry contact closure or 12VDC@100mA voltage trigger

ports.name: HDMI (OSD Out)
ports.note: On-screen display video output, 720p/1080p; HDMI version not published

ports.name: RTI-COM
ports.note: Two-way Zigbee communication port (proprietary, RJ45-keyed) for ZM-24 module

ports.name: USB Programming
ports.note: Front-panel USB port for Integration Designer programming; exact sub-connector type unconfirmed

ports.name: Power In
ports.note: 12VDC 1A external power supply (same PS-2-style adapter used across RTI XP series); barrel jack internally tied to the +12VDC terminal block pin
